pages.title: About
pages.text: The hottest planet: the real surface of Venus reaches 464 °C. Tier 3 rocket. Gravity is about 53% of Earth's. It has the highest pressure of any world you can reach, plus corrosive acid rain.

pages.title: Protection
pages.text: A light spacesuit is not enough: you need a $(l:space/survival/space_suit)heavy one$() or a $(l:space/tech/space_base)Gravity Module$() with Stabilization. Use thermal protection against the heat. Acid and corrosion wear gear down, so carry spares.

pages.title: Resources
pages.text: Aluminum, copper, galena, quartz, silicon, tin and solar ore. A Geothermal Generator draws heat from below, so there is plenty of power.

pages.title: The dungeon
pages.text: You land in an Entry Pod. Juicers live on the planet, and the Spider Queen guards the treasure: she shoots webs, poisons and summons spiders. Her key leads onward.

pages.title: Station
pages.text: You can build an atmospheric space station around Venus. It is easier than the surface, though still warmer than Earth.

pages.title: Geothermal Generator
pages.text: Makes power from the planet's heat.
